requirements.title: Omitted FORM= default depends on access method
requirements.definition: If FORM= is omitted, the default is UNFORMATTED for direct or stream access and FORMATTED for sequential access.

pending.form-default-by-access: Concrete INQUIRE plan: use three named files and prefill each FORM inquiry variable with a nonmatching sentinel such as '###########'. (1) OPEN one file for sequential access while omitting FORM= and INQUIRE by unit with FORM=; per 12.10.2.12, FORM= is assigned FORMATTED for a formatted connection, and 12.5.6.11 makes omitted FORM= default to FORMATTED for sequential access, so assert exactly FORMATTED. (2) OPEN another file with ACCESS='DIRECT' and a positive RECL while omitting FORM= and INQUIRE FORM=; assert exactly UNFORMATTED. (3) OPEN a third file with ACCESS='STREAM' while omitting FORM= and INQUIRE FORM=; assert exactly UNFORMATTED. Supplemental data-transfer controls may use matching formatted/unformatted operations, but the primary default oracle is the INQUIRE token.

review_rationale: Source registration for the OPEN statement and its specifiers, 12.5.6.1-12.5.6.19 (batch151). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across four rounds. Round 1 found required OPEN defaults with only generic plans and required default tokens over-suppressed as unobservable; both are now concrete sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE plans (ACCESS, ASYNCHRONOUS, BLANK, DECIMAL, DELIM, FORM, PAD, LEADING_ZERO, SIGN, and ROUND as set membership). Rounds 2 and 3 found that INQUIRE(POSITION=) reports connection STATE, not the omitted OPEN token, and that a re-OPEN plan observes 12.5.6.1 p6 rather than the POSITION default; the omitted POSITION= token is now recorded as not portably observable, as are the STATUS and ENCODING default tokens. The eight numbered rules R1204-R1207 and C1203-C1206 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
